name: reclaimllm
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code. Search captured ReclaimLLM sessions, recover prior decisions, and export reusable context.

api_key.title: ReclaimLLM API Key
api_key.description: Your ReclaimLLM API key. You can also authenticate with `rclm-hooks-install --with-mcp`, which stores credentials in ~/.reclaimllm/config.json.

server_url.title: ReclaimLLM Server URL
server_url.description: Optional ReclaimLLM API base URL. Defaults to https://api.reclaimllm.com when using the rclm installer.
